# קלין סטוק — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Clean Stock is a marketing brand specializing in cleaning products, fragrances, and ambiance-enhancing products. The brand targets a broad audience including homes, offices, and businesses, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution for cleanliness and pleasant atmosphere. The brand carries a fresh, clean, and professional vibe, combining practicality with sensory experience through scent and ambiance.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About קלין סטוק
Clean Stock is a marketing brand specializing in cleaning products, fragrances, and ambiance-enhancing products. The brand targets a broad audience including homes, offices, and businesses, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution for cleanliness and pleasant atmosphere. The brand carries a fresh, clean, and professional vibe, combining practicality with sensory experience through scent and ambiance.

## Target Audience
- בתים, משרדים ועסקים
- משפחות עם ילדים
- משרדים ועסקים קטנים
- צרכנים ידידותיים לסביבה

## Industry
Cleaning & Home Fragrance Products
